statement: nodes-p1 remains non-priority while one serial goal-state owner, given current owner-authored recovery-eligible quorum, transport, inventory, and source/leader evidence, emits at most one executable formation move per tick or progresses the existing transition; missing evidence emits none, ordinary placement remains fail-closed, only real heartbeat owners renew admission leases, and the unchanged MovieLens gate passes 5-of-5 formation probes followed by 3-of-3 full demos.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

nodes-p1 must remain priorityControlPlane=false. Do not activate priority emergency scheduling, reserved budgets, replay, direct wakeup, publication visibility, admission bypass, or any other broad priority lane.

Formation target admission requires explicit current CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY_ELIGIBLE=true evidence plus transport, quorum, usable inventory, and source/leader actuals. Missing, false, stale, or ambiguous evidence fails closed; no repair or planner path may synthesize or renew node status or ready leases.

The nodes-p1 formation path must reuse the immutable EffectivePlacement owner, emit at most one new move per partition tick, and progress an unresolved existing transition before emitting another spread move.

Before any live run, a real UnifiedRebalancer.checkRebalance red-on-revert proof must cover the archived co-located nodes-p1 shape, exactly one executable move with an eligible quorum, and zero moves for sub-quorum, unavailable eligibility, unusable inventory, unavailable source or leader, and unresolved-transition cases; ordinary system and non-system controls remain unchanged.

Before the terminal gate, run a fresh thermally valid controlled N>=2 fixed versus N>=2 exact-revert A/B and compare outcome milestones, in-flight operations, level-50 events, and nodes-linked warnings. Reject the change if it repeats the prior no-improvement or load-amplification result.

The terminal live gate is 5-of-5 formation-probe repetitions green followed by 3-of-3 full-demo repetitions green on unchanged scenarios and one unchanged source fingerprint; thermally invalidated failures are non-measuring, and budgets, deadlines, workload, joins, preload size, ratings split policy, and report semantics are unchanged.
